text: Code reviews are a vital part of software development. When a developer writes new code, a colleague carefully examines it before it is saved to the main project. This process helps catch bugs early, which saves both time and money later. Instead of discovering errors in a finished product, problems are fixed immediately. Furthermore, code reviews are an excellent tool for knowledge sharing. Team members learn from each other’s techniques and gain a better understanding of different parts of the project. Most importantly, this habit improves the overall quality of the team’s work, building trust and encouraging clear, consistent communication.
